title: Kadison's similarity theorem through uniform derivation estimates
summary: We prove that every bounded complex-linear unital algebra homomorphism from a unital complex C ∗ -algebra into the bounded operators on an arbitrary Hilbert space is similar to a $`*`$-homomorphism. This resolves Kadison's similarity conjecture positively. We also obtain one universal hyperreflexivity constant for all unital von Neumann algebras on arbitrary complex Hilbert spaces.

review.reason: Proves Kadison's similarity conjecture via uniform derivation estimates for C*-algebra homomorphisms.
